about_the_game:
Ever dreamed of conquering the world? Now’s your chance with this limited demo of GENERAL IDLER. Start small and expand your empire by strategically invading neighboring countries. Build your army, upgrade military tech, and unlock new units, all while managing resources and planning your next move.

In this demo, you’ll get a taste of the full game experience: conquer territories based on geography, progress through simple yet satisfying idle mechanics, and explore the beginning stages of world domination. With limited features and playtime, this demo offers a glimpse into the addictive strategy, deep tactical decisions, and rewarding progression that GENERAL IDLER has to offer.

Key Features (Demo):

  • Strategic Conquest: Only attack neighboring nations, with limited units and resources to manage.

  • Idle Progression: Earn rewards and expand your empire even when offline.

  • Tactical Decisions: Build and upgrade units, with a taste of the tech tree and military progression.

  • Limited Duration: Play for a set time or until your demo progress ends, then unlock the full experience in the full game.

Command your forces, conquer your neighbors, and start your journey to world domination! The full experience awaits.
